## Type

- [ ] feat — new user-facing capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] perf — measurable performance improvement
- [ ] refactor — internal restructuring, no behaviour change
- [ ] chore — internal / no user impact (deps, CI, build, etc.)
- [ ] docs — documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where it makes sense
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added if user-facing
  (`sdk/CHANGELOG.md`, `backend/CHANGELOG.md`, `frontend/CHANGELOG.md`
  — whichever applies)
- [ ] Disclaimer / "AnnexKit is not a law firm" copy untouched
  (or change is approved separately)
- [ ] Architecture non-negotiables preserved
  (deterministic classifier · append-only audit log · privacy-by-default
  · thin controllers/fat services · async everywhere · types on
  everything · permanent disclaimer)
